22:29.text: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."

22:30.text: , and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you.
